name: Remotli
business_model: free posting with optional paid upgrades
notes: Standard posting is free. Optional Featured and Premium upgrades are paid, and the page says pricing may change after a test. Public job search needs no key. Account endpoints need a self-serve key created by a job seeker account.

review.note: Employer pricing and API docs read; footer says one-person project and no partner program or country of headquarters stated.

sources.title: Employer posting page
sources.quote: Post free, or pay to stand out

sources.title: Employer posting FAQ
sources.quote: Featured (CHF 149) and Premium (CHF 299) are optional upgrades, paid by card through Stripe at submission

sources.title: API documentation
sources.quote: The public search needs no key; the account endpoints act as the person whose key they carry.

sources.title: Remotli homepage
sources.quote: Remote-first and flexible roles from companies hiring in Switzerland.
